en.title: [Inha University Graduate School of Manufacturing Innovation] Recruitment of New Students for Master's, Doctoral, and Integrated Programs (Spring 2027)
summary: Notice on student recruitment for Master's, Doctoral, and Integrated programs for Spring 2027 at Inha University Graduate School of Manufacturing Innovation (제조혁신전문대학원).
The application period is from October 26, 2026 to November 6, 2026.

Admissions information sessions will take place in two rounds: 1st session on Oct 22 at Yonghyeon Campus (60th Anniversary Memorial Hall, Room 508) and 2nd session on Oct 26 at Aerospace Campus (Room 205).
Registration for the information sessions is available via the Google Form link.
en.easyExplanation: Inha University Graduate School of Manufacturing Innovation (제조혁신전문대학원) is recruiting new students for Spring 2027 Master's, Doctoral, and Integrated programs. Interested students should apply during the application window from October 26 to November 6, 2026. You can register for the information session via Google Form.
